name: @altv/desktop
description: altv desktop app (Electron): the altv server and web UI in one hardened, offline-first window.
author: altv

scripts.pack:dir: pnpm --filter @altv/web build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --dir
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm --filter @altv/web build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm --filter @altv/web build && node scripts/bundle.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --win --publish never
